app-skill-frontmatter-migration.title: App Skill Frontmatter Migration to agentskills.io format
app-skill-frontmatter-migration.description: Migrate the 17 existing app skill SKILL.md files in app/src/main/assets/app_skills/<package>/ from the old frontmatter format to the agentskills.io-compatible format. Old: name: <package.name>. New: name: app-<short-name> (lowercase-hyphen, e.g. app-settings, app-chrome) and metadata: { package: <package.name> }. Directory structure (keyed by package name) and AppSkillRepository load path remain unchanged in this task. Naming guidance: short-name = user-recognizable app name, not the package suffix.
acceptCriteria: All SKILL.md files under app/src/main/assets/app_skills/ have name: app-<short-name> in lowercase-hyphen format
All SKILL.md files have metadata.package field with the original Android package name
All files validate against SkillFrontmatterParser (description present, name matches lowercase-hyphen regex)
./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests *AppSkill* passes (loader still finds bodies by directory)
find app/src/main/assets/app_skills -name SKILL.md | xargs -I {} grep -l "^name: app-" {} | wc -l matches the directory count
